name: Operational Ontology Registry Persistence Schema
description: Implement Phase 2A registry-service ontology persistence schema: five DB tables, generated source migrations, schema-level tests, and documentation updates while keeping store/service/index-meta sync out of scope.

userStories.title: Inspect Existing Registry-Service Schema Patterns
userStories.description: As a registry-service implementer, I want to document existing Drizzle schema and test patterns so that ontology persistence tables follow the repo's current conventions.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify naming conventions for table names, primary keys, unique indexes, JSON fields, timestamps, lifecycle/status fields, and check constraints.
Identify whether the implementation should use composite primary keys or unique indexes for each ontology table.
Identify existing SQL/schema tests or migration snapshot patterns.
Add brief implementation notes to the ontology registry allocation TODO or a new memo/spec section.
Do not add ontology tables in this story.

userStories.title: Add Namespace and Axis Tables
userStories.description: As a registry-service implementer, I want ontology namespace and axis tables so that registry-service can persist ontology identity and axis registrations.
acceptanceCriteria: `ontology_namespace` includes `owner`, `lifecycle`, `created_at`, `updated_at` fields following existing registry-service conventions.
Add lifecycle check constraint for allowed namespace lifecycle values.
`ontology_axis` has primary key or unique key equivalent to `(ontology_id, axis_id, version_id)`.
Add lifecycle check constraint for allowed axis lifecycle values.
Update the schema file header comment so the documented table count/list includes the new ontology tables.

userStories.title: Add Taxonomy Table
userStories.description: As a registry-service implementer, I want an ontology taxonomy table so that taxonomy registration can persist axis composition and identity-axis information.
acceptanceCriteria: `ontology_taxonomy` has primary key or unique key equivalent to `(ontology_id, taxonomy_id, version_id)`.
Add lifecycle check constraint for allowed taxonomy lifecycle values.
Schema leaves referenced-axis existence validation to a documented store/service-level check if DB foreign keys are not practical.
JSON field names follow the convention established in US-001.
Update the schema file header comment if table count/list changed in this story.

userStories.title: Add Allocation and Segment Tables
userStories.description: As a registry-service implementer, I want ontology allocation and segment tables so that reserved/active/deprecated address allocation state can be persisted.
acceptanceCriteria: Add check constraints for allowed `address_model` and `status` values.
Segment primary key or unique key is equivalent to `(allocation_id, segment_id)`.
Update the schema file header comment so the final table list/count is correct.
No index-meta sync or `address_state_cache` behavior is implemented.

userStories.title: Generate Migration or Schema Snapshot
userStories.description: As a registry-service maintainer, I want the schema migration/snapshot updated before SQL tests run so that the ontology persistence tables are reproducible in local and CI environments.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `pnpm --filter registry-service db:generate` or the repo-approved registry-service Drizzle generation command.
Generated migration files are placed under `packages/registry-service/drizzle/**`.
Commit only source migration files under `packages/registry-service/drizzle/**`; do not commit `packages/registry-service/dist/**` generated output.
Generated migration output includes all five ontology persistence tables.
Generated output preserves global `(prefix, version_id)` uniqueness.
Generated output includes lifecycle/status/address-model check constraints when supported by the existing Drizzle pattern.
No unrelated migration churn is introduced.

userStories.title: Add Schema-Level Persistence Tests
userStories.description: As a registry-service maintainer, I want schema-level tests for ontology persistence so that table creation and uniqueness constraints are verified after migration generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or extend registry-service schema/SQL tests for the five ontology persistence tables.
Tests run against a DB initialized from registry-service migrations, not only `schema.ts` metadata.
Test axis duplicate key rejection for `(ontology_id, axis_id, version_id)`.
Test taxonomy duplicate key rejection for `(ontology_id, taxonomy_id, version_id)`.
Test allocation duplicate key rejection for `(prefix, version_id)`.
Test allocation duplicate key rejection for `(ontology_id, taxonomy_id, version_id)`.
Test segment duplicate key rejection for `(allocation_id, segment_id)`.

userStories.title: Reflect Phase 2A Completion in Docs and TODO
userStories.description: As an ontology documentation maintainer, I want Phase 2A completion reflected in spec/todo docs so that the next PRD can start at store adapter work.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `operational-ontology-registry-allocation.todo.md` to mark Phase 2A schema and migration/snapshot items complete.
Update `operational-ontology-registry-allocation.spec.md` to summarize the persisted table surface.
Update `operational-ontology-registry-persistence-handoff.spec.md` only if implementation choices refine the handoff contract.
Keep Phase 2B store adapter items open.
